report.savePanelMessage: OnKey's records for a bug report: logs and numbers, no lyrics or audio.

infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: OnKey listens to your singing to show how in tune you are. Your recordings stay on your Mac.
infoPlist.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: OnKey listens to the music playing on your Mac to learn the singer's melody. It never saves the music or sends it. In listening mode a short fingerprint of it (not the audio) goes to Apple's Shazam to name the song.
infoPlist.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: OnKey asks Spotify, Music or your browser (for YouTube) what's playing and controls playback when you press play, skip or start over.
